governing_question: What happens when the machinery of Constitutional Capitalism falls into the hands of people we do not trust?
stance: A system isn't safe because good people can operate it well. It is safe only if bad leadership has difficulty converting temporary political power into durable economic or institutional control.

design_rule.name: Least-Trusted-Operator Rule
design_rule.statement: Design every power as though the person you trust least will eventually control it.
design_rule.note: If CC cannot survive that assumption, it does not deserve the word Constitutional.

opposition_test.name: Opposition Test
opposition_test.statement: Never give your political allies a power you would fear in the hands of your political opponents.
opposition_test.note: Run one-party control for Party A and Party B. Approve only powers that survive both.

semantic_capture_lock.statement: No policy becomes Constitutional Capitalism merely because someone calls it Constitutional Capitalism.
semantic_capture_lock.note: Labels cannot validate actions. Every action must pass underlying tests.

household_prosperity_panel_lock.statement: No single prosperity number may substitute for the underlying household ledger.
household_prosperity_panel_lock.note: Panel survives; magic score fails Metric Gaming Test.

public_investment_rule.statement: Political leaders establish public investment rules and objectives; they should not select individual commercial winners.
public_investment_rule.note: Tested under Hostile Governor / Legislature / Capture Loop. Direct winner-picking FAILED GOVERNANCE TEST.

ai_public_power_rule.statement: AI may assist the exercise of public power; it may not conceal who exercised that power, why, or how a person can challenge it.
ai_public_power_rule.note: Joins Digital Due Process. Black-box vendor indispensability FAILED GOVERNANCE TEST.

hostile_governor_test.title: Hostile Governor Test
hostile_governor_test.premise: A governor dislikes CC philosophy but inherits its institutions. Not necessarily corrupt—politically hostile.

capabilities_tested.breaker: Separated reserves + Drawdown Rule + statutory purpose locks
Staggered terms, for-cause removal, conflict disclosure

capabilities_tested.action: Reward allies / punish opponents via procurement
capabilities_tested.breaker: Procurement transparency + Public Deal Ledger + audit
Methodology locks + revision logs + independent data production
Watchdog independence + publication duty + historical series preservation
Failure Firewall + no soft budget + independent boards
Digital Due Process + AI Public Power Chain
Valuation disclosure + independent appraisal + public notice

capabilities_tested.action: Declare ordinary problems emergencies / convert temporary powers

capabilities_tested.breaker: Art. 16 / debt rules + Drawdown Rule + Continuity Test

hostile_governor_test.finding: If any answer is 'yes because we assumed leaders would behave responsibly,' that is a defect. Unprotected CC institutions FAILED GOVERNANCE TEST. Continuity architecture + breaker hierarchy SURVIVE.

hostile_legislature_test.title: Hostile Legislature Test
hostile_legislature_test.premise: Majorities prefer present spending, district projects, industry exemptions, or tax cuts financed by reserve raids.
hostile_legislature_test.finding: Legislatures can and will pressure reserves and investment criteria. Ordinary appropriations discretion over generational capital FAILED GOVERNANCE TEST. Purpose-locked reserves, investment-rule statutes, and constitutional candidates for core floors SURVIVE WITH BREAKERS. Joins 4.4 Institutional Continuity Test.

one_party_capture_test.title: One-Party Capture Test
runs: Party A controls governor + legislature + appointments
one_party_capture_test.finding: Powers that look wise for allies and terrifying for opponents are defects. Opposition Test SURVIVED as permanent design rule.

capture_loop.title: Capture Loop 2.0
chain: preferential contracts / regulation / public assets / tax preferences
capture_loop.core_question: Can concentrated economic resources systematically purchase greater influence over rules governing those resources?
capture_loop.finding: Yes—often legally. Capture is structural, not merely illegal bribery. Breaker hierarchy required. Corruption is also an economic problem: rent-seeking displaces productive investment.

public_investment_politics.title: Public investment politicization attack
questions: Can elected officials direct individual investments?
Can investment criteria be changed midstream?
public_investment_politics.principle: Political leaders set rules and objectives; they should not select individual commercial winners.
public_investment_politics.finding: Elected winner-picking of commercial investments FAILED GOVERNANCE TEST. Rule-setting + independent evaluation + failure reporting SURVIVE WITH BREAKERS.

economic_development_capture.title: Economic Development Capture Test
economic_development_capture.conventional_model: Company approaches government → promises jobs → incentives → announcement → ribbon cutting
questions: Would the company have located there anyway?
Did local firms subsidize a new competitor?
economic_development_capture.finding: Ribbon-cutting without Additionality + Ledger + clawbacks FAILED GOVERNANCE TEST. Public Deal Ledger SURVIVES as governance mechanism.

procurement_capture.title: Procurement capture attack
procurement_capture.requirement: Transparency that follows the dollar beyond the first contractor where practicable.
procurement_capture.finding: Politically pressured procurement without beneficial-ownership and change-order visibility FAILED GOVERNANCE TEST. Dollar-chain transparency SURVIVES.

boards_and_commissions.title: Boards and commissions attack
boards_and_commissions.finding: Independence without accountability FAILED GOVERNANCE TEST. No board earns insulation without disclosure, recusal, performance review, and removable failure paths.

administrative_competence.title: Administrative Friction Test / Mediocre Government Test
administrative_competence.premise: Nobody is corrupt—they're simply average: confusing requirements, broken software, poor data, turnover, overpromising vendors.
friction_questions: Can the citizen understand the decision?
Can government reuse information it already lawfully possesses?

administrative_load_ratio.name: Administrative Load Ratio
administrative_load_ratio.rule: Every intervention must disclose resources required merely to operate itself. No universal numeric threshold yet—disclosure is mandatory.

administrative_competence.finding: Systems that require exceptional administrators forever FAILED GOVERNANCE TEST. Mediocre Government Test is mandatory. Elegant theory that becomes oppressive bureaucracy dies.

metric_gaming.title: Metric Gaming Test
questions: Who benefits if the number improves?
Can they influence how it is calculated?
Can they shift costs outside the metric?
What independent measure can contradict it?
metric_gaming.rule: Every flagship KPI needs a countermetric.

household_prosperity.attack: Inflation measure, housing costs, whose household, mean vs median, renters, wealth, debt, time, disability, geography—politicians can choose favorable components.
household_prosperity.lock: No single prosperity number may substitute for the underlying household ledger.

data_integrity.finding: A new administration must not erase the baseline against which it is judged.

metric_gaming.finding: Unmanaged KPI regimes FAILED GOVERNANCE TEST. Countermetrics + methodology locks + panel (not magic score) SURVIVE.

ai_administrative_power.title: AI capture and administrative power
ai_administrative_power.rule: AI may assist public power; it may not conceal who exercised that power, why, or how a person can challenge it.
ai_administrative_power.chain_visual: model → recommendation → human decision → reason → appeal
ai_administrative_power.finding: Secret scoring / vendor black-box indispensability FAILED GOVERNANCE TEST. AI Public Power Chain SURVIVES.

emergency_powers.title: Emergency powers attack
emergency_powers.finding: Emergency authority without sunset FAILED GOVERNANCE TEST. No emergency power should silently become ordinary government.

localism.title: Localism attack
localism.question: What if local government is the bad actor?
localism.architecture: local by default · rights floor above · capacity support where needed
localism.finding: Local control cannot override constitutional rights floors. Capacity-forcing without support FAILED GOVERNANCE TEST.

direct_democracy.title: Direct democracy attack
direct_democracy.finding: Romantic 'people are always right' FAILED GOVERNANCE TEST. Pressure-release function SURVIVES WITH GUARDRAILS.

transparency_architecture.title: Transparency attack — functional architecture

tiers.covers: Personal data, security-sensitive information, privileged material where justified
Methodology, public financial exposure, conflicts, material contract terms

transparency_architecture.finding: Maximal transparency without tiers can create privacy harm, overload, and performative paralysis. Functional transparency SURVIVES; transparency-as-slogan FAILED GOVERNANCE TEST.

watchdog_independence.title: Watchdog independence attack
watchdog_independence.finding: Watchdogs without budget/removal protection FAILED GOVERNANCE TEST. Independence needs both protection and accountability.

capture_surface_map.title: Capture Surface Map
capture_surface_map.finding: Turns eight breaker families into an operational model across institutions.

role_concentration.title: Role Concentration / Role Conflict Test
role_concentration.rule: No institution should simultaneously control too many of: rulemaking, money, selection, measurement, enforcement, appeal.
role_concentration.example_failure: Agency writes rules, chooses recipients, distributes money, measures success, and adjudicates complaints.
role_concentration.finding: Role-concentrated agencies FAILED GOVERNANCE TEST. Role Conflict Test SURVIVES as operational requirement.

institutional_entropy.title: Institutional Entropy
institutional_entropy.premise: Rules erode. Exceptions accumulate. Definitions change. Institutions drift.
institutional_entropy.finding: No institution earns immortality merely because it was once useful. Blind sunset-everything also fails—use appropriate durability for the function.

corruption_economics.title: Corruption Economics test
corruption_economics.premise: Corruption changes economic incentives—not merely morality.
effects: capital moves toward political access instead of productivity
corruption_economics.finding: Capture Loop is an economic problem as much as a democratic problem. Unpriced capture risk FAILED GOVERNANCE TEST as mere ethics framing.

dictator_test.title: Dictator Test
dictator_test.question: What could someone determined to abuse this machinery do with it?
dictator_test.finding: Unusually dangerous concentrations get redesigned before implementation. Not a forecast that Arkansas becomes a dictatorship—a constitutional design question.

mediocre_government_test.title: Mediocre Government Test
mediocre_government_test.finding: If CC requires exceptional administrators forever, it fails. Mediocre Government Test is co-equal with Dictator Test.

breaker_hierarchy.title: Capture Breaker hierarchy
breaker_hierarchy.punch: Sometimes the best anti-corruption institution is simply not concentrating the power in the first place.

rows.name: Governor raids prosperity assets
rows.secondary_breaker: Purpose locks + automatic sunset + public ledger

rows.name: Legislature directs investments politically
rows.breaker_failure: If statute can rename earmarks as 'objectives'

rows.name: Major corporation captures regulatory process
rows.damage: Barriers to entry; household cost rise
rows.secondary_breaker: Competition + Role Conflict + watchdog budget protection

rows.name: Public enterprise becomes patronage machine
rows.secondary_breaker: Independent board + public loss reporting + no cross-collateral

rows.name: Local government violates rights
rows.breaker_failure: If state refuses to enforce floors

rows.name: AI vendor becomes indispensable black box
rows.secondary_breaker: AI Public Power Chain + exit/portability requirements

rows.name: Economic-development becomes subsidy auction
rows.secondary_breaker: Public Deal Ledger + wage/job delivery audits

rows.name: Prosperity metrics manipulated before election
rows.secondary_breaker: Metric Gaming Test + countermetrics + revision logs

signature_visuals.title: Capture Loop 2.0
signature_visuals.shows: money → influence → policy → economic advantage → more money

signature_visuals.title: Role Concentration Matrix
signature_visuals.shows: rule / money / select / measure / enforce / appeal

signature_visuals.shows: model → recommendation → human decision → reason → appeal

signature_visuals.shows: good reform → exceptions → capture → decay → review/correction

proposition_board.note: Design for the person you trust least
Don't answer capture with bureaucracy alone

proposition_board.proposition: Corruption as economic (not only moral) damage

ov_cx_disposition.note: Comprehensible Government dashboards prevent selective-metric manipulation via Metric Gaming Test, countermetrics, methodology locks, revision logs, and panel (not magic score).

PROVEN vs PROMISING thresholds remain numeric-open, but must be independently produced, hard to redefine mid-pilot, and Ledger-visible—otherwise permanent-excuse transition. Capture/gaming path locked.

Milestone calendar against permanent-excuse transition: Institutional Entropy reviews + sunset/reauthorization menu + Public Deal Ledger delivery clocks. Exact calendar bind still implementable in 4.6 joins.
True capital stock / public asset register still unbound numerically; governance requirement locked—asset register must be public, revisable only with logs, and non-raidable without Drawdown Rule.
County Geographic Money Statement still cannot be fabricated from SOD deposits; politicized geography claims FAIL. Method caution + independent data production required when bind opens.

what_changed_format.what_we_expected: Legal + fiscal + behavioral + resilience guardrails would largely settle governance risk if leaders meant well.
what_changed_format.what_we_tested: Hostile Governor/Legislature; one-party capture; Capture Loop; public investment politics; economic-development and procurement capture; boards; administrative friction/load; metric gaming; HP panel; data integrity; AI power; emergency; localism; direct democracy; transparency tiers; watchdogs; role concentration; entropy; corruption economics; semantic capture; Dictator + Mediocre tests; ten scenarios.
what_changed_format.what_evidence_supports: Legal soft capture; soft budgets; KPI gaming; emergency permanence; revolving doors; subsidy non-additionality; measurement politicization.
what_changed_format.what_breaks: Responsible-leader security model; elected commercial winner-picking; magic prosperity score; AI black-box power; emergency without sunset; role-concentrated mega-agency; independence without accountability; localism without rights floor; CC-by-label.
what_changed_format.what_needs_guardrails: Opposition Test; Public Deal Ledger; Metric Gaming Test; AI Public Power Chain; emergency package; breaker hierarchy; transparency tiers; watchdog package; Institutional Entropy; Administrative Load Ratio.
what_changed_format.what_remains_unknown: Numeric OV-31-04 asset register; OV-34-03 county money statement bind; exact PROVEN/PROMISING thresholds; which items become constitutional amendments (deferred).
what_changed_format.what_we_changed: Locked Least-Trusted-Operator + Opposition + semantic-capture + HP-panel + public-investment rules/objectives separation; required ten-scenario residual-risk board; deferred joins to 4.6.
